title: The Double Deadline Again
author: Petra Quintana
blurb: Emrys Winterbourne, a whistle-blower living under four names, hasn't slept through the night since the incident. Then every record of a flight vanishes while it's still in the air — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must extract a defector who may be the bait before the border checkpoint shifts change.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
